Then GCD(90,120)=? Since 90=2*45, 120=2*60, so GCD(90,120)=2*15=30. Similarly GCD(36,48)=12. Then GCD(72,96)=? 72=2*36, 96=2*48, so GCD(72,96)=2*12=24.
